scope: Independent preparation only, no candidate/family/production approval
definitionOfGood: A purposeful softly rounded blue wreck corner with substantial hull rails, dark iron bracing and pale fasteners, readable open bays and clean true W/N connections to approved native modules in every facing.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: The L turn reads as crafted continuous wreck construction. Blue hull pieces and iron reinforcement have substantial rounded or softly faceted volume. Native proportions, topology, count, joins in the interior and purposeful decoration may improve beyond weak source geometry.
Keep the source blue/cyan hull family, distinct darker slate iron and pale fasteners. Restrained cream wear can explain edges; avoid dominant yellow bands or large featureless near-black surfaces.
Broad soft colored highlights describe form in all four views. Keep one horizontally symmetric native rig with no directional ground shadow, white glare, painted glow or fringe.

Purposeful shallow chips, grain, dents or crafted fastening details distinguish aged blue hull from iron. Decoration supports the turn structure and remains coherent at phone32; literal imagegen cracks, stacked-board count and marks are optional.

At logical128 the corner, structural rails, iron and pale hardware read immediately; at phone32 the corner and material hierarchy remain legible. Open bays and rail spaces are intentional and continuous, with no forced opaque fill across legitimate openings. All views belong to one native object.

Both actual W and N contacts are visibly clean in true native L and actual independently composed current-consumer L at all4/light-gray-dark/logical128/phone32. No local crack, slit, seam stripe, step, doubled cap, abrupt normal/material change, black patch, halo, clipping or dead spot. Source/native equality or numerical field correspondence never waives a visible defect.

immutableVersusFreedom.locked: Registered capture/roots/static timing/atlas and gameplay ports/clearances plus root-reconciled own finite budget. Exact approved native canonical fields and rig are technical authorities.
immutableVersusFreedom.free: Interior modeling, useful native construction, proportions, decoration, topology, part count, equivalent actual field storage/graphs and normals. No literal custom-normal/Principled/storage identity veto.
